identity.description: An attacker uses a legitimate Windows binary to inject malicious code into a running process, which is detected by Cortex analytics. This behavior mimics a typical LOLBAS attack pattern for process injection.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: LOLBAS Process Injection
biocs.description: Detection of suspicious process injection via legitimate Windows binaries
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'rundll32.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'regsvr32.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'inject.exe'

abiocs.name: Process Injection via LOLBAS
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detected when a legitimate Windows binary injects into another process
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'rundll32.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'regsvr32.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'inject.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'inject.exe'

xql_queries.name: LOLBAS Process Injection Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'rundll32.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'regsvr32.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'inject.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name
